# MindCheck Tools, Complete Canonical Reference

> MindCheck Tools provides browser-based screening instruments, self-reflection tools, calculators, guided exercises, and educational guides.
> Some pages implement published validated instruments; other tools are educational or self-reflection resources. None provides a diagnosis or medical advice.

All interactive answers and scores are processed locally in the browser. Sensitive tool routes do not load analytics or advertising. Optional services on eligible public pages require consent. No account is required to use the tools.

## Important limitations

- A screening result is not a diagnosis.
- Seek a qualified healthcare professional for evaluation, diagnosis, or treatment.
- Use [crisis resources](https://mindchecktools.com/crisis-resources) for urgent support information.
- See [privacy](https://mindchecktools.com/privacy), [methodology](https://mindchecktools.com/methodology), and [clinical evidence](https://mindchecktools.com/clinical-evidence) for scope and safeguards.
